subject.title: fix(plugins): detect orphan diagnostics with explicit code marker (2-part fix)

question: Should this PR keep the legacy no-code missing-source invalidation in runtime stale detection, or should legacy cleanup move to doctor/migration before merge?
rationale: The explicit diagnostic marker follows maintainer feedback, but the legacy no-code branch changes upgraded persisted-registry behavior and needs maintainer intent on the migration boundary.

options.title: Keep Runtime Invalidation After Proof
options.body: Accept the bounded cache rederive behavior once the contributor adds visible latest-head legacy-upgrade proof.

options.title: Move Legacy Cleanup To Doctor
options.body: Require the no-code upgrade cleanup to live in doctor/migration code and keep runtime stale detection limited to explicit codes and pluginId-bearing diagnostics.

options.title: Accept Current Proof As Enough
options.body: Maintainers can waive the remaining proof ask and merge based on source inspection, tests, and the contributor's prose confirmation.

recommendation.title: Keep Runtime Invalidation After Proof
recommendation.body: Accept the bounded cache rederive behavior once the contributor adds visible latest-head legacy-upgrade proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They gave the explicit-marker direction on the predecessor and have recent ownership signals in the affected plugin discovery/registry path.
